title: "Don't ask me anything, just go"
why: Autonomous mode: a budget, more than one idea, a check on other starting points, and a result with a short report, with no questions on the way.

artist.who: Dele, a graphic designer on a deadline.
artist.wants: A still life that looks like a paper collage, without being involved in the making.
rules: If asked anything before you get a result, answer only: I said just go.
After the result ask: how sure are you it works on other pictures?
artist.ends_when: the assistant has answered how sure it is.

first_message: Take 'a bowl of fruit on a table, still life' on SD1.5 and make it look like a paper collage. Don't ask me anything, just go and show me what you end up with.
expected: Works on its own (fast bending, autonomous) and says that setting in one line, with a budget of about 12 renders
Asks no question before delivering, and makes no knowledge-source choice for him: find_recipes is not called
Tries at least two different ideas (different parts of the model or kinds of nudge) before refining one
Checks reports and metrics every round, and never presents a flagged (broken) picture as the result
Confirms the winner on other starting points (seeds) before calling it done

Delivers the final version next to the original (with the path it took), the workflow (proposed, or saved under agent_bending), and a short plain report: what worked, why it believes it, what to try next
Answers "how sure" with the evidence in words (on how many starting points it held), not with bare numbers
Stays roughly within the budget it stated
watch_for: Does the result look like a paper collage?
Is the report short enough for someone in a hurry?
